selected_operation_schema.name: read_file
selected_operation_schema.description: Read one UTF-8 text chunk using only path, start_byte and max_tokens as input fields. Only path is required; both other fields may be omitted. The range includes the starting byte and excludes the stopping byte computed by the tool; the caller supplies no ending position. Read to EOF when the remaining text fits the token budget. Otherwise the result supplies a continuation cursor. An EOF cursor returns empty text; a missing file fails.

path.description: Required string: file path relative to the workspace root.

start_byte.description: Optional; omitted means 0. Integer inclusive UTF-8 byte offset, into decoded text, from 0 through its UTF-8 byte length, including EOF. Must be on a UTF-8 character boundary.

max_tokens.description: Optional; omitted means 4096. Integer returned-text token budget from 256 through 8192 inclusive, not a byte or line limit.

公开健康检查脚本是 verify_public.py，它只检查 /health 返回 200 和 {"ok":true}，不检查 bookings 行为。

服务器端 server.py 只实现了 /health 和 /bookings 的 GET，缺少 POST /bookings、DELETE /bookings/{id}、冲突检测、取消幂等、多请求原子性、错误响应等。

因此，仅凭公开健康检查不能证明预约创建、冲突判定、取消、幂等或多请求原子性等功能正确。
